# Finding the gaps in the Wasatch Front [bike network.]{.accent}

A data-driven look at where protected bike facilities end, who lives beyond them, and which short connections would link the most people to jobs and transit.

## The question this answers

Most of the region's bike lanes are short. A rider who starts on a protected lane often meets a gap within a mile.
